What’s in this version?

The journal’s steps so far, from first release to current version.

    Still ahead

    Online address and business search, downloadable offline maps, and integrated navigation. Permanent APK signing is deferred until testing is finished.

    Maps use an online background. “Nearest to me” compares your saved footprints; it does not search for new businesses. FootPrints is still in testing.

    Move the map beneath the pin, or tap a spot. You can also focus the map and use the arrow keys. This changes your draft only.
